```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

library(tidyverse)
library(tximport)
#library(DEseq2)

setwd("D:/canine-seq")
wd <- getwd()
```

```{r}
sample_sheet <- read.csv(file.path(wd, "/data/ORBIT/sample_sheet.csv"))

gtf_file = paste0(wd, "/reference/dog/canfam4/", "Canis_lupus_familiarisgsd.UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0.116.gtf.gz")
gtf <- import(gtf_file)

tx2gene <- mcols(gtf) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name) |>
  distinct() |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(transcript_id))

write.table( #move this to correct folder
  tx2gene,
  file = "tx2gene.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
kallisto.path = file.path(wd, "results", "ORBIT", "kallisto")

files <- file.path(list.dirs(kallisto.path)[-1], "abundance.h5")
names(files) <- gsub(paste0(kallisto.path, "/"), "", list.dirs(kallisto.path)[-1])

txi <- tximport(files, type = "kallisto",
                tx2gene = tx2gene,
                txOut = FALSE,
                ignoreTxVersion = TRUE)

raw_counts <- as.data.frame(txi$counts)
```

```{r}
summary(raw_counts[,1])
#hist(log2(raw_counts[,1] + 1))
sum(raw_counts[,1] > 0) #number of expressed genes
```

```{r}
top_idx <- order(raw_counts[[1]], decreasing = TRUE)

head(data.frame(gene = rownames(raw_counts)[top_idx],
                count = raw_counts[[1]][top_idx]),20)
```

```{r}
ggplot(raw_counts) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(x=raw_counts[[1]]), stat = "bin", bins = 200) + 
  xlab("Raw counts") + 
  ylab("Number of genes")
```

```{r}
ggplot(raw_counts) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = log2(raw_counts[,1] + 1)),bins = 100) +
  xlab("log2(count + 1)") +
  ylab("Number of genes")
```


```{r}
sampleTable <- data.frame(
  sampleName = names(files),
  condition = c("treated", "treated", "control")
)

sample1 <- sample_sheet |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id == "ORv-01__LN_FNA_Day_28.FC22K7HFLT1_L1_ICACAATAGGA-TCCATCCGAG")

library("DESeq2")
ddsTxi <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi,
                                   colData = sample1,
                                   design = ~ timepoint_days)
```
